uniqueKeyFinding.finding: The question asks WHAT planned burns remove. Option3 names ladder fuels and adds that they are removed by mechanical thinning. Yosemite L55 proves mechanical removal is used; it does not prove fire cannot consume the same materials. Dead/overgrown fuel and ladder fuel are not established disjoint classes. FAQ L72 explicitly includes live and dead burnable vegetation in burn planning; L91-L92 describes cut limbs/dead brush later burned. Thus the relative clause does not supply a factual exclusion for the broad WHAT question. Note2 contrasts removal for replacement, but option2 actually says keeping meadows open, and NPS positively discusses meadow health; that contrast does not refute the actual alternative.
uniqueKeyFinding.limits: No claim that every prescribed burn consumes all ladder fuels or that a second key is universally proved. The required unique-key/wrong-option exclusion is not supported by these full contexts, so PASS is withheld.
